items.claim: Gillian Robertson is very aggressive, inflicts damage, and aggressively pursues finishes.
items.quote: she's [ __ ] nasty, inflicts damage, will go for wins, uh go for or go for finishes.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson holds the advantage in the striking department over Mackenzie Dern.
items.quote: On the feet, I leaned Robertson.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has historically struggled with consistently securing takedowns.
items.quote: She's had a lot of problems with getting takedowns consistently

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern tends to absorb significant damage in fights while trying to set up her takedowns.
items.quote: will take a beating. Like she's been busted up in quite a few fights because it takes her so much time to finally get that takedown.

items.claim: If Gillian Robertson ends up fighting from underneath Mackenzie Dern on the ground, she will lose.
items.quote: If she's underneath Mackenzie Dern like she's losing.
